title: Sensitivity adaptation
summary: Aim skill is built on adaptable mouse control rather than one untouchable sensitivity, so controlled sensitivity changes can expose weak coordination patterns and broaden movement options.
cues: Treat sensitivity as a tool, not an identity
Use a time-boxed alternate sensitivity block to challenge a plateau
Track whether the change improves control quality, not just comfort
failureModes: Assuming any sensitivity change destroys progress
Changing sensitivity randomly every session with no purpose
